verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://docs.honeybadger.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the product. The docs also publish topic-split agent-oriented reference files under /_llms-txt/ (product, insights and other references) that an agent can be pointed at directly.
